setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 5, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (5, 2))
xy = centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 2))
df = pd.DataFrame({'umap_x': xy[:, 0], 'umap_y': xy[:, 1], 'score': rng.normal(size=n), 'cluster': [f'c{v}' for v in k]})

steps.name: switch to columns mode and apply
run prepare in coords mode and wait for ready
steps.report: { phase: a.phase, nKept: a.nKept, coordsMode: a.prepared.coordsMode, dims: a.prepared.dims, allXYLen: a.allXY ? a.allXY.length : null, anchorXY0: a.anchorXY ? +a.anchorXY[0].toFixed(3) : null, allXYAtAnchor0: a.allXY && a.anchorPos ? +a.allXY[a.anchorPos[0] * 2].toFixed(3) : null }

steps.name: verify allXY data range (non-trivial spread from input columns)
steps.eval: (function() { const xy = a.allXY; const nd = 2; const n = xy.length / nd; let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = xy[i * nd], y = xy[i * nd + 1]; if (x < minX) minX = x; if (x > maxX) maxX = x; if (y < minY) minY = y; if (y > maxY) maxY = y; } window.__xySpreadX = maxX - minX; window.__xySpreadY = maxY - minY; })()

steps.name: color by cluster
steps.report: { colorColumn: a.colorColumn, categories: a.colorMeta ? a.colorMeta.categories.length : null }

steps.name: hover shows tooltip at anchor 0
steps.eval: const xy = a.anchorXY; a.onPointer({ x: 400, y: 300, world: [xy[0], xy[1]] })

steps.name: UMAP and Result sections are hidden in columns mode
UMAP section is visible after switching back
